clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, a scorpion’s venom can bring a hunter near death, while its poison sac holds what alchemists need to make a cure.

Scorpids roam Durotar’s red rocks, including Venomtail Scorpids, Corrupted Scorpids, and the Death Flayer. Their tail sacs hold a fast-acting venom that can overwhelm even seasoned warriors if left untreated. The same sacs contain the primary compounds alchemists need to make an antidote. When a scorpion stung the hunter Rhinag outside Orgrimmar, local alchemists needed four fresh poison sacs to make a remedy and neutralize the venom in his veins.
